description: Defines the AliasAnalyzer class for analyzing tensor aliasing and lifetimes within a computational graph in the torch::nativert namespace.

classes.name: AliasAnalyzer
classes.description: Performs alias analysis and lifetime management for values in a computational graph.

methods.name: get_sources_of_alias
methods.description: Returns the source values that alias the given value.

methods.name: lifetime
methods.description: Retrieves the lifetime information for a given value.

methods.name: is_alias
methods.description: Checks if a value is an alias of another.

methods.name: is_storage_associated_with_output
methods.description: Checks if a value's storage is associated with a graph output.

methods.name: values_associated_with_output_storage
methods.description: Returns the set of values associated with output storage.

methods.name: alive_values_at_time
methods.description: Returns the list of values alive at a specific time index.

methods.name: update_aliases_if_packed_listunpack
methods.description: Updates alias information for list unpack operations.

methods.name: maybe_update_aliases_from_schema
methods.description: Updates aliasing based on schema specifications.

methods.name: create_or_update_lifetime
methods.description: Creates or updates the lifetime info for a value.

methods.name: maybe_extend_lifetimes
methods.description: Propagates lifetime information from outputs back to sources.

methods.name: squash_deep_aliases
methods.description: Ensures alias chains point directly to source values.

methods.name: log_state
methods.description: Logs the internal state of the alias analysis.
